subset.reproduce: Offline fontTools 4.66.1 Subsetter: glyph_names=True, layout_features=[*], name_IDs=[*], name_languages=[*], exact listed Unicode points, WOFF2/Brotli 1.2.0. Preserve original name table, head bbox, hhea extrema and OS/2 xAvgCharWidth; recalcBBoxes=False and recalcTimestamp=False. No build/runtime fontTools dependency.

privateAssets.note: Since 9 October 2026 the site lives in the public MIT monorepo. Entries marked private are proprietary (IRANSansX, licensed to the owner for application use) and are NEVER committed: the directory is git-ignored and filled by scripts/prepare-private-fonts.mjs. Only their checksums are public. Without them the build serves a documented system-font fallback for Persian.

fontLoading.policy: One preloaded117-point primary; non-preloaded original Latin/full faces. All keep blocking display and exact disjoint cmap ranges covering the complete original full source.
